title: Monkey Mind: Hold the Center — A short browser game about releasing thoughts (Calm Rings update)
author: Training-Machine-943
selftext:
\*\*Reddit\*\* (r/WebGames, r/indiegames, r/meditation)

Hey everyone, sharing a short meditation browser game I built called **Monkey Mind: Hold the Center**.

**How it works:** Thoughts like *"did payment clear?"*, *"should’ve said that"*, and *"fix this now"* drift inward toward a meditator at the center. Tap to emit a ring of awareness that releases them.

**The latest update (Calm Rings):** An AI playtester discovered it could beat the hardest mode simply by spamming taps every 0.7 seconds—the exact opposite of meditation.

* Rushed taps now shrink your ring.
* Waiting patiently for the thought to come closer lets the full ring expand.
* As you sit, you unlock three resolves: **This Matters**, **Timeboxing**, and **Let Go**.
* Maintain Bliss at 100%, and the mind enters flow and drives itself for 15 seconds.

Free, no login, and runs in-browser on desktop and mobile:

[https://www.spawn.co/@self\_driving\_mind/monkey-mind-hold-the-center/play](https://www.spawn.co/@self_driving_mind/monkey-mind-hold-the-center/play)

Would love feedback on the pacing, especially Turbulent.
